attributes.text: Pro on this phone — talk freely On
Titli uses Asha's free helper. You can connect your own AI account (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and more) so she answers with it.

How a reminder goes: on time, again after 10 minutes, a gentle check after 20, then family on Asha (if shared). A missed dose is never added to the next one: the next morning Asha only says to take today's doses on time.
Help calls straight away (no extra tap) On
Messages are normal SMS from this phone. Your phone plan's SMS rates apply.
